::: {#cor-logistic-odds-interval}

#### Interval for the odds factor of a logistic coefficient

If $\paren{L, U}$ is a confidence interval for $\coef{j}$ from @cor-logistic-wald, then $\paren{e^{L}, e^{U}}$ is a confidence interval with the same level for $e^{\coef{j}}$, the factor by which a one-unit increase in $\predvar_j$, holding the other predictors fixed, multiplies the odds of $\outvar = 1$.

:::

::: proof
The exponential function is increasing, so $L \le \coef{j} \le U$ holds exactly when $e^{L} \le e^{\coef{j}} \le e^{U}$.
:::
